summary.en: Deep cuts are optional. Hits are valid entry points. No apology required.
summary.zh: 深切是可选项。热歌是合法入口。不用道歉。

body.en:
Someone online will ask if you know the B-side. You do not owe them a quiz score.

Most rock fans start with a radio chorus, a film cue, a parent's CD, or a short clip of an old riff. That is normal distribution, not a lesser origin.

A simple habit: play the landmark track on a band page once without multitasking. Then play one neighbor—related band, pioneer genre, or a member who left and started over. Do that a few times a week and your map fills in faster than comment-section shaming suggests.

Gatekeeping runs on shame because shame is cheap. Curiosity is slower. Tropes on this site name the rituals—"creative differences," "classic lineup," "you had to be there"—so you can spot them without taking the exam.

Bring the taste you have. Expand it later. Nobody grades your receipt.
body.zh:
网上总会有人问你知不知道 B-side。你不欠他们考试分。

多数摇滚听众从电台副歌、电影配乐、父母的 CD，或一段老 riff 短视频开始。这是正常传播路径，不是低配起源。

简单习惯：乐队页 landmark 认真听一遍，别一边刷别的。再听一个邻居——相关乐队、开创流派，或走人另起炉灶的人。一周几次，地图会比评论区羞辱暗示的更快填上。

装门禁靠羞耻，因为羞耻成本低。好奇更慢。本站的梗把仪式点名——「创作理念不合」「经典阵容」「你当时不在场」——好让你认出来，而不去考一场虚设的试。

带着现有品味来。以后再扩。没人批改小票。
